answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow: each agent locks 70 in a vault and files a fingerprint of its work rhythm, key-stamped. Each epoch one fingerprint is replayed by an auditor against the horizon of past work; when a sequence is copied, rented, or mistimed, the bond burns and a ripple runs through the ledger. First filing 46, k-th 46+5(k-1); forging a thousand costs 2,543,500, locks 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 46 once.
